findings.issue: Collapsed sidebar showed legacy CSS hover labels alongside TooltipButton help.
findings.fix: Removed navigation pseudo-element tooltip rules; retained the workspace summary tooltip.
findings.regression: Five-theme browser test collapses the sidebar, verifies one tooltip, and verifies Escape dismissal.

findings.issue: Removing help text while a tooltip was open left aria-describedby pointing to an absent tooltip.
findings.fix: Only append the tooltip ID when both open and title are present.
findings.regression: Unit test removes help text while focused and verifies the original description remains.

Final staged diff and regression results; all review findings resolved.
